notes: The 2026 Towson news notice says the program is free, with free daily lunch. The one-credit course is Exploring Careers in Education.
name: TU Teacher Scholars Summer Institute
what_you_do: Four days on campus learning what teaching is like, with professor-led activities, a visit to the child care center, the planetarium and library. Earn one college credit.
who_can_apply: High school students interested in teaching. Applicants are selected.
pay_detail: Free. Lunch is provided each day.
duration: 4 days, 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. (2026: July 13 to 16)
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened in February 2026 and the session ran July 13 to 16. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Towson College of Education page when registration opens, likely in February. Contact Assistant Dean Omari Jackson, 410-704-3877.
